title: 1991: Rebuilding Central European Cooperation
grammar: Diplomatic conditionals of consensus and desirability (kívánatosnak tartaná, elengedhetetlennek ítélné)
goal: I can explain the re-establishment of the Visegrád cooperation in February 1991 by Antall, Havel, and Wałęsa.
I can use diplomatic conditionals of desirability (kívánatosnak tartaná, hajlandóságot mutatna) in negotiations.
I can describe the joint V4 efforts towards Euro-Atlantic integration (NATO, EU) and dismantling Soviet-era blocs.
